text:
Brother:
I will look for you behind the street corners.
And you will not be there.

I will look for you in the cloud of birds.
And you will not be there.

I will look for you in a beggar’s hand.
And you will not be there.

I will look for you, too,
in the Golden Initial of a Book of Prayers.
And you will not be there.

I will look for you in the gnomes’ night.
And you will not be there.

I will look for you in the air inside a music box.
And you will not be there.

(I will look for you in the children’s eyes.
And there you will be.)

translation.title: Envío
